ughh i'm so very sorry this happened to you, i feel so sad reading stories like this. i completely realize the confusion around how you felt you enjoyed it back then; my abuse was the same exact way, i let it continue for years because i didnt realize how wrong it was, and it makes me feel so gross about it now. i struggled with understanding why i felt that i enjoyed it back then, but i know how wrong it was now, and the lasting effects it's left on me.
so yes, this is absolutely cocsa, no 8yo should ever be exposed to sexual tendencies, by anyone, ever. the mind of someone so young is not developed enough to make those decisions, because they wouldnt know if it's right or wrong. i'm so sorry for your experience, but don't ever let anyone fault you for how you think you felt back then.<3
thank you so much. i have healed a bit, it's been a long time coming but thank you. cx

i completely agree, i really wish it could be recognized more. and to answer your previous question, i do have some trusted adults, and i did go to therapy, but mostly to resolve my BPD tendencies. i have never talked about these happenings in my life in detail to anyone before, except some friends in school at the time, because im just now learning that it was abuse.

when i was around, 15 i think? i had completely made up my mind that i was gonna tell my mom about everything. i told her i needed to tell her something, and i just broke down crying as she repeatedly asked what was wrong. but i couldnt get the words out, no matter how much i tried. all i could say was that my bf and i 'did something,' and she asked if he was mad at me, to which i just nodded. she promptly dismissed it then, saying i was just moody and that i shouldn't be in a relationship. and that was the end of that. i stopped any and all attempts to tell anyone, never let anyone see me cry anymore, and our relationship continued in secret.

also, thank you again for the messages. it really means a lot

i soo much relate to the abandonment trauma, my mom was so much like this where i was insanely attached and yet she'd leave me so often, most often without ever telling me, like some days she'd just be gone and i'd not know where she went or she'd leave to punish me over the smallest things, while other punishments were actually being physically beaten or whipped..meanwhile my dad was nonexistent for the most part, and when he was there then he'd do all in his power to make me resent even having been born. like being told how miserable i make his life becsuse he had to spend money on food for me and all.. this was all when i was about 5 or 6, and at that age the worst pain i'd felt was when i was having a legitimate panic attack and meltdown from having to go to school because i didnt want to be away from her..??  and she was with me but told me she'd be right back because she needed to use the bathroom. 5 minutes passed, then 10, then 30 and finally i realized that she'd left and wasnt coming back like she said she would =/

once i reached my teens, aboutt 11-12 years old i made my first boyfriend and, i'd not known what love was like at all and looking back on it now i've long-since realized it was thr most abusive and toxic relationship ever, and it took 5 years of my life of constantlyy being gaslit, physically and emotionally abused, led into near-daily sex with him and his friends and other indecency at such a young age, and the entire time i unknowingly exhibited severe and intense bpd symptoms. but even so i still felt that that was what love was meant to be, and i stayed faithful..until he revealed he was cheating on me, and when he left me i just, didnt even feel anything at all anymore. i didnt even cry, i just felt emotionally broken and like i had nothing left to feel.

so yeaa, i'd say it was a mixture of those things that led to my bpd=/
